{title}

{body}
""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog post for secure web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. text : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized, HTML‑formatted string ready for rendering on the page. Raises ------ ValueError If either `heading` or `text` is empty or consists only of whitespace. """ if not heading.strip(): raise ValueError("Heading must contain non‑whitespace characters.") if not text.strip(): raise ValueError("Text must contain non‑whitespace characters.") # Escape any HTML special characters to prevent XSS. safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) # Preserve line breaks by converting newlines to
tags. safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True).replace("\n", "
\n") # Insert the sanitized content into the predefined template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_text)
